reviews.text: Visited Wenshu Monastery on the second day of the Lunar New Year. It is widely known as a place associated with wisdom, and many people come to pray for academic success or career progress. The cultural weight of the temple is evident, especially during the festival period. We arrived early, yet the crowd was already dense. On the first day of the New Year, the queue can reportedly reach four hours. Even on the second day, the atmosphere was intense but orderly, filled with incense and quiet determination. The temple carries a long-standing heritage. Compared in prominence to Yonghe Temple in Beijing, it feels both solemn and deeply rooted in local life. In moments like this, tradition feels less distant and more present

Serenity and History at Wenshu Monastery. A tranquil oasis right in the heart of Chengdu at Wenshu Monastery—1,400 years of calm, culture, and spiritual vibes all hidden behind leafy courtyards and intricate halls. There are 5 buildings along straight route from main entrance. Number 6 building can be reached from side path of 2nd building. Tips Arrive right at 8:00 AM to soak up tranquility before tour groups show up. Dress modestly—shoulders and knees covered. Navigating: Chengdu Metro Line 1—get off at Wenshu Monastery Station, just a short walk away. Temple grounds are slippery after rain—watch your step! Photos inside the prayer halls are not allowed; respect the signs and monks’ privacy. Entrance to temple is free. Joss stick and water provided after main entrance. Good to spend about 2-4 hours if you have time.

I liked this monestary. I have visited twice, just because I was twice in the area. Fort time it was over Chinese hollidays and it was full of people, many of them practicing prayers. It was very nice to see them in the holy visit. Next time was 3 weeks later, during the week and no holliday. It was much less crowded, but also lowe feeling of holy place that is in use. Probably this monestary was the only place I liked more over hollidays than later:)
A very pleasent monastery with ancient calligraphy. The only thing is not allow to take picture inside the temple. You can still take outside scenery.

Walkwd in an hour and a half before closing and the crowd was getting smaller. A very tranquil place right in the middle of the city. The outside wall of the Monastery very "Instagramable" - red wall with Chinese characters.

The monastery hosts several temples and buildings with beautiful architecture. The main prayer hall called the Dharma-? Hall is most impressive with beautiful ceiling and wood panels on the walls. The grounds also host buildings used as tea houses and food places serving all vegetarian food. The food offerings includes a Vegetarian Hot-Pot. Yes, you heard that right. It was such a great find. Loved the whole complex.

Such a quiet and beautiful monastery. Went there in the morning to enjoy the peaceful place. It opens at 8. You’ll be amazed with the beauty of the different type of Buddha statues. About 200. And the most iconic is the Jade one.

A peaceful and spiritual spot in the heart of Chengdu. Wenshu Monastery is beautifully maintained, with serene gardens, intricate architecture, and a calming atmosphere. It's a great place to slow down, reflect, and experience traditional Buddhist culture. Definitely worth a visit if you're in Chengdu!
Free entry and very relaxing. Nice contrast to the busy city. Take about 30mins -1 hour to slow wonder about. Lots of tourist shops and restaurants surrounding the area.
Quiet temple, composed of different buildings and parcs, with free access, surrounded by tourists shops.
Free entrance and easily accessible via metro. Beware of scammers outside Chinese temples in China offering you fortune telling services. Just ignore them and walk on.
Small place to spend a peaceful morning. There are chinese calligraphy on the two sides.
A popular temple frequented by many locals. Was busy. The streets around the temple was bustling with local eateries and shops. Good for a short 1-2hr look around and to grab a light local meal.

Didn't bear much expectation before visiting but was blown away the moment I stepped into the Monastery during winter. I came just right on time during winter to experience the vibrant yellow ginkyo leaves season. Walking around the Monastery gaves me a sense of inner peace.

Wenshu Monastery in Chengdu is a peaceful haven, offering a blend of rich history and spiritual serenity. Its exquisite gardens and ancient architecture captivate all who visit. A must-see for tranquility seekers!
Neatly layouted temple ground. Building are historic and well kept. Joss sticks are free and free hot tea given at door.

Such a beautiful and tranquil place; it's free to enter with lots to see and some restaurants inside also. One of the most beautiful places in Chengdu and definitely worth a visit. The surrounding neighborhood is interesting to walk around as well.

entry is complimentary. one of the smaller temples in the city worth visiting if you have time to spare; though not as nicely maintained. regardless, a nice refuge from a very busy and bustling gigantic city.
Amazing place! Two months later, I’m still thinking about how amazing was to see and hear the monks praying. I would definitely go back (in the morning, so I can hear them again)
Free entrance. Can feel the art of the building. Feel peaceful when seeing all the statues.
Amazing place to visit in Chengdu. Walk through the Manjushri monastery which has Tibetian influence. At the periphery there is a shopping area for collecting souvenirs
Beautiful place. It was a little crowded but made it more interesting. Didn't realize how big it was from the entrance. Make sure you bring your Kleenex and sanitizer for the toilets.
Beautiful monastery and temple, with some old-fashioned shopping streets and stalls nearby.

Very nice and well mantained garden with a cozy teahouse nearby. Interesting monastery with an open library for anyone interested in budhism. Even if not curious about it, a definetely should visit if you are passing by.
It’s a peaceful place during the day I went there, it’s a rainy day. There many souvenir shops around and sell items in reasonable prices
A nice place to get to see a Chinese Buddhist monastery. There is a tea house at the same place.

I didn’t go into the Wenshu yuan but it’s a library with Buddhism scripts. The noodle store outside the wenshu yuan is good especially the 白凉粉。price is really affordable too. You need to pay at the cashier first to get 2 takeaway bowls if u don’t want to wait for a seat. Once u got the paper bowls, go to the side window where u will see food being prepared, to get your takeaway orders to eat by the street.
Very peaceful and beautiful Buddhist monastery and temple. Has a garden, a tea house, and a fantastic vegetarian buffet from 11:00 to 2:00.
We spent a few hours at the teahouse on the second floor. It was the most relaxing time in Chengdu!
I love this place, there's a few places that you are not allow to tale pictures, you cam buy a red candle for 15 yen and make a wish
Holy place with long tradition. Nice structure with a suggestive backyard with lighting candles.
Amazing - went early in the morning in autumn. Beats the crowd and can appreciate the garden in autumn/winter
One of the tourist attractions in Chengdu. Lots of local food options and shops. Perfect for walking tours
Went last year, this is a jewel in the rough. We had the most serine beautiful. I would go back if I got a deal on flight.
Nice temple, but not quite as stunning as some of the others in Chengdu. Best to visit in the evening.
Our visit coinsided with a special ceremony lighting 10,0000 candles. We where invited to stay and participate in the ceremony.
A unique Chinese temple which is said to be a most popular place to achieve one`s academic or career progress by placing a wish here and singing your prayers here.

The #1 visited religious place in Chengdu. Most of the temple buildings are the original from Qing Dynasty, built in 1697AD. The back of the temple is a big Zens- style park/ garden. There is a teahouse serving tea and vegetarian meals.
Walking distance from downtown, free entrance ticket, some good sightseeing inside like the turtle pond, big garden and free tea. Outside the temple has many foods and snacks decent price
Very big area with nice garden inside. The temple has many buildings all beautiful. Best part is the vegan buffet, cheap and delicious with many options. You can also opt for Vegan hot pot.

There a tea garden next to the wenshu yuen,that for me was more cool place. The temple itself was well mantained and clean but didnt feel very holy( if u know what i mean) plenty of tourist traps aurroubdibg it, dis not help.

Nicely done landscape design. Great for a walk. U can see kids playing arounds, people walk their pets, jogging, dancing and singing. This place is beautiful and pack with many sellers who sell historical item and antics.

Very beautiful and spacious Buddhist Temple located near the Caoshi Street residential area in Chengdu. Many statues and candles along with a variety of incense promotes an atmosphere of peace and tranquility. On Saturday morning, there was a kind of swap meet near the temple entrance where people were selling some old books and other rare novelties. Very easy to spend hours looking around and seeing all the various Buddha alters.

A peaceful Buddhist temple. Also has a amazing kitchen serving vegetarian buffet, hotpot and tea. The variety was good, they even offer a 5rmb discount coupon for your next visit. The buffet cost 35 Yuan per person. Around the temple you also find outlets serving local snacks.
Worthy to pay a visit while in chengdu , and stroll around the small historic alleys coped with tea shops and restaurants
Beautiful monuments and architecture. Lush green vegetation with spiritual tranquility. Plenty of vegetarian food available. Never forget to enjoy aromatic tea.
Only if you are a Buddhist - it is suppose to be the 4 top scarce Buddhist temple to visit in China. Still worth a quick visit if you have the time and happened to be in the area
Fabulous temple. Set in lovely grounds. Would recommend. Surrounding neighbourhood fun and entertaining with shops and restaurants

One of the nicest part to stay in Chengdu. Still within vicinity of Chengdu city centre, connected with buses and metro subway Station. Hotels are definitely cheaper than city centre. This area you'll get the mix of old and new part of Chengdu.
Absolutely beautiful and it also has a monastery buffet canteen that offers outstanding (vegetarian) food at great prices!!
It is a wondrous temple with a lot of information; when you go inside, please show respect and don't take a photo of the face of any of the ideals
Quiet in a wonderful Place. If you can visita It in the early morning at the opening.
It is a very nice temple and monastery that is famous and does not charge visitors a fee to enter or burn incense.
The Buddhist vegetarian food served here is amazing. Had a couple of mock meat items that I couldn't differentiate from meat. Overall amazing.
Loved the ambience, architecture, beautiful deities, traditional presentation, cleanliness, continuous religious chanting going on and the holy vibrations of the place - truly uplifting
An active Buddhist temple with school and library. Nice quiet place to walk around a bit. If you are a believer, then do visit.
One of the best Buddha temples I’ve ever visited. Calm and peaceful. Good for those who are interested in Buddha culture.
Nice place in the city. Active Buddhist temple, garden and tea house. Many places around for eating and shopping souvenirs.
Wenshu Manjushri temple is one of the best we ve visited in our 2weeks trip in sichuan, streets outside are nice places too
An oasis of relative calm right in the middle of Chengdu city (well...). Definitely no pandas sold here.
A historic temple with the young praying and payingancestral respects using joss sticks is a new experience.
เป็นวัดจีนโบราณเก่าแก่ขึ้นชื่อของเมืองเฉินตู มีจุดให้ไหว้พระหลายจุดมาก พระแต่ละองค์รู้สึกได้ถึงความศักดิ์สิทธิ์ หากใครมาเฉิงตูต้องมาที่วัดนี้นะครับ

隋の時代に建てられ1400年以上の歴史がある寺院。有名な三蔵法師の頭頂部の一部が安置されているらしい(非公開)。平日でも賑わっていてツアー団体が次々に押し寄せて来ていました。 入場無料、開門時間8:00〜17:00、地下鉄1号線の文殊院（Wenshu Monastery）駅 K出口から徒歩約5分。 屋根の角の反り部分と、そこにぶら下がる風鐸を皆さん一生懸命撮影しています☺︎ 12月初旬はまだ銀杏の紅葉が残っていました。銀杏の名所としても知られる文殊院で、色鮮やかな風景を見ることが出来良かったです。
走進文殊院，成都的喧囂瞬間靜了下來。這裡不只可禮佛祈福，更能坐在古樹下喝杯蓋碗茶，嚐一口清爽素齋。精美的古建築與悠閒的茶客相映，無需專程趕路，就能深刻感受這座城市那份從容溫潤的生活底色。

이 곳 문수원은 당나라 시대에 자리잡은 곳이라 하니 약 1,300년이 넘은 유서깊은 고찰 입니다. 중국 젊은 여성들께 어떤 통설이 전해지는지 모르겠지만, 특정 포인트에서 사진을 찍기 위해 긴줄을 서서 기다리는 분들이 많았구요. 긴 차례를 기다려 불공을 드리는 젊은 분들도 많았습니다. 사찰 규모가 아주 큰 편은 아니지만, 볼거리가 많고 잘 관리되고 있는 곳이라 느껴졌는데요. 스님 외 일하시는 분들뿐 아니라 종교적인 행사에 참가하는 불자도 많았고, 각 건물 내 모셔진 불상 역시 제각기 다양한 개성과 재료로 만들어져 흥미가 느껴지더라구요. 특히 불교에 관심있는 분들은 충분한 방문 사유를 뷸러 일으키는 곳입니다.

Un monastero ottimamente conservato, carico di spiritualità, emozionante e coinvolgente. Vedere molti fedeli inginocchiarsi davanti al Buddha ha un forte impatto. Il profumo di incenso è inebriante. Unico mio errore essere andato troppo tardi al mattino, quando era stracolmo di visitatori. Purtroppo i cinesi hanno questo vizio di perdersi in selfie ovunque prepotentemente sciupando il momento di ammirazione. Entrata gratuita, surata visita consigliata almeno 30 minuiti
사람들이 많이 방문하는 장소. 꼭 청두 여행을 팬더만 보러 가지 말고 이런 사원에 방문하면 다른 느낌을 받을 수 있습니다. 무료 입장했었습니다. 휴일이라 사람이 많았지만 문제가 있을 정도로 많은 것은 아니었습니다.
文殊院始建于隋大业年间（605~617年），初名信相寺，明末毁于战火，仅存铁铸神像和两株古杉。清康熙三十六年（1697年），慈笃禅师于废墟结茅修行，因夜现文殊菩萨祥瑞，得官方支持重建并更名。康熙四十年（1701年）获御赐“空林”匾额，故又名“空林堂”。 到中國喜歡照一些古色古香的歷史建築 習慣趕早一開門就進入拍照（比能照到無人入鏡的空景），尤其是遇週末

Năng lượng trong lành, chùa đẹp lắm Kế đó có quán trà, và 1 gian riêng mn có thể viết thử pháp hay đọc sách. Phía ngoài cổng của là 1 đoạn kiểu phố cổ nhỏ cũng ok lắm, bán nhiều đồ lưu niệm. Chúc mn bình an, khoẻ mạnh và có chuyến đi vui
역사적 유적지라고 해서 방문했는데, 볼만한 것이 없었습니다. 정원도 잘 가꾸어지지 않은 것같습니다. 근처의 거리도 볼 것이 없었습니다. 택시타고 방문했다가 30분만에 다시 택시타고 돌아왔습니다.

文殊院真係一個好特別嘅地方。雖然佢就喺市中心，但一入到去，嗰種喧囂感覺即刻消失晒，變咗一份難得嘅寧靜。 文殊院唔單止係間廟，佢仲係一個充滿文化氣息嘅地方。建築風格好有古韻，飛簷翹角，雕樑畫棟，每一樣都睇得出歷史嘅痕跡。行入唔同嘅殿堂，你會聞到淡淡嘅香燭味，睇到好多人喺度誠心禮佛，個氣氛好莊嚴。 除咗大雄寶殿同天王殿，入面仲有個園林，亭台樓閣、小橋流水，一步一景，好舒服。行到攰仲可以去佢哋嘅素食館，試下地道嘅齋菜，清淡得嚟又好味。 我最大嘅感受係，文殊院俾到一個空間人哋可以放低煩惱，好好咁同自己相處。無論你係信佛定係純粹想搵個地方靜吓，呢度都係一個好選擇。下次去成都，文殊院絕對值得一去，體驗下嗰種獨特嘅平和感。
Bellissimo tempio al centro della citta, molto particolare vedere la condraddizione tra il tempio antico e i grattacieli moderni intorno
文殊院新年祈福，人潮避擁擠。 文殊院建於清朝年間，並才開始有了這個名字，個人覺得實在不必要牽扯上很久很久以前的那個信相寺。 從建築到佛像都沒什麼特別的，不是信徒或者當地人的話可以不用浪費時間來了。而且不知道是不是現在流行建佛學院，這裡也有個空林講壇，不過看其招生廣告似乎只招收男士。
好多年没来文殊院了 小时候经常姥姥带到来文殊院看菩萨 现在打造得非常的巴适了 里面还可以吃斋饭喝茶写毛笔字那些传统艺能 这次来才认真听了义务讲解介绍文殊院的历史 隋唐时期修的 里面供奉了玄奘的顶骨舍利 佛堂有僧人念经 特别庄严肃穆 参观完结缘了几本佛经回切学习还可以结缘佛像 菩萨回切供起 都是免费赠有缘人

文殊院｜Wenshu Monastery｜วัดเหวินซู เป็นวัดพุทธเก่าแก่ที่มีชื่อเสียงของเมืองเฉิงตู อีกทั้งยังเป็นศูนย์กลางของสมาคมชาวพุทธของมณฑลเสฉวน วัดสร้างขึ้นในสมัยราชวงศ์สุ่ย ปี605 - 617 เดิมที่ชื่อ "วัดซินเซียง" (信相寺庙) จนกระทั่งในปี 1697 สมัยปีที่ 36 ของราชวงศ์คังซี ได้ให้มีการบูรณะวัดขึ้นมาใหม่ โดยมีหลวงพ่อซีตู้เป็นแกนนำซึ่งเชื่อว่าหลวงพ่อเป็นภาคหนึ่งของพระโพธิสัตว์มัญชุศรี และได้เปลี่ยนชื่อวัดเป็น "文殊院 Wénshū yuàn เหวินซูย่วน" นับตั้งแต่ นั้นมา ⏰ เวลาเปิดปิด : 08.00 - 17.00 💰 ค่าเข้าชม : ฟรี การเดินทาง : 🚇 Metro Line 1 (สายสีน้ำเงิน) ลงสถานี Wenshu Monaster ทางออก K เดินจากสถานีไปอีกประมาณ 600 ม.
文殊院，顧名思義主祀文殊菩薩，當然也包含了不少其他的神靈，位置就在地鐵1號文殊院站出口處，有橫直二條不短的參道，還有為數不少的卜卦算命問休咎的攤位，商家林立相當熱鬧。 對所有經歷文革後的大陸，不管是廟宇、庵堂、道觀都無一倖免的情況下，神像幾乎都是重雕新塑，殿堂院落也無不經過整修重建，但歷史還在位置也不變，心誠則靈並無罣礙。

อารามเหวินซู #วัดเหวินซู 文殊院 วัดพุทธเก่าแก่กว่า 1000ปี ใหญ่ที่สุดของเมืองเฉิงตู ที่นี่ถือเป็นศูนย์กลางของสมาคมชาวพุทธของมณฑลเสฉวน สร้างขึ้นในสมัยราชวงศ์ถัง เดิมทีเรียกว่า วัดซินเซียง ในปี ค.ศ.1681 ช่วงรัชสมัย จักรพรรดิคังซี แห่งราชวงศ์ชิง (1644-1911)ได้ให้มีการบูรณะวัดขึ้นมาใหม่ มีตำนานเล่าว่า สมัยนั้นมีพระภิกษุซือตู้​ ที่จำพรรษา ณ วัดแห่งนี้มรณภาพลงและถูกนำร่างไปเผา กลับปรากฎภาพพระมัญชุศรีโพธิสัตว์ในเปลวเพลิง ผู้คนจึงเชื่อว่าพระซือตู้เป็นพระมัญชุศรีกลับชาติมาเกิด วัดซินเซียงจึงเปลี่ยนชื่อมาเป็นอารามเหวินซูนับแต่นั้นมา คำว่า เหวินซู 文殊院 Wénshū หมายถึงพระมัญชุศรีโพธิสัตว์ ผู้เป็นเลิศด้านปัญญา นั่นเอง ⏰ เวลาเปิดปิด : 08.00 - 17.00น. 💰 ค่าเข้าชม : ฟรี
大陸四川省的文殊院供奉的主神是佛祖釋迦牟尼佛，文殊菩薩反而四處尋找上香禮拜不著(連最後面的文殊閣都去啦)！ 多處莊嚴的佛菩薩塑像(如鍍金的千手觀音像等)另人肅然起敬，恭敬不已)! 大門口不遠處的上千年古塔，恭敬的繞塔三圈，法喜充滿啦！ 文殊院販售佛教文物處，我也買到在臺灣家中正需要購買的細長型短香(有檀香、艾草香兩種)，物美價廉，已歡喜買購帶回家備用囉！讚!!
วัดสวย สะอาด มี จนท. ดูแลหลายจุด คอยให้คำแนะนำ มีน้ำชาเสริฟฟรี น้ำชาอร่อย หวานหอม นอกวัดมีร้านขายของที่ระลึกหลายจุด ราคาไม่แพง
Quartier très sympa avec beaucoup d'animations, vendeurs de rue. Le monastère est intéressant.
古色古香的寺院，建築及文物保留完整，週邊的店始建於隋朝，在明朝毀於兵火，清康熙舊址重建，康熙御賜「空林」匾額一塊，因此文殊院又名空林堂。 今建築面積20餘萬平方米，是中國長江上下游四大禪林之首，很值得一遊。 週邊店家林立，各有特色，想吃特產，想買伴手禮，應有盡有！

始建於隋朝大業年間，初名信相寺，相傳是當時隋文帝之子蜀王楊秀之寵妃為當時的比丘尼信相所建。 唐末五代時改名為妙圓塔院。宋代改回信相寺。 明末毀於兵火，建築俱焚毀，唯留下10尊鐵鑄護戒神像和2株千年古杉。 清康熙二十年（1681年），慈篤禪師來到殘垣中結廬坐禪，周邊村民見慈篤禪師入定處夜裡放大光明，皆驚異，謂其為文殊菩薩化身。從此慈篤禪師四處遊方，聲名遠揚；康熙帝仰慕其名，曾三次召他入京面聖，都被婉言拒絕。康熙三十六年（1697年），官民在信相寺舊址籌建寺院，稱為文殊院。康熙四十一年（1702年），康熙帝御賜「空林」匾額一塊，因此文殊院又名空林堂。嘉慶、道光年間，方丈本圓法師主持擴建了文殊院。 今建築面積20餘萬平方米，是中國長江上下游四大禪林之首，設有戒壇，為周邊四川僧俗受戒之道場。1980年7月7日公布為四川省文物保護單位、1983年，國務院確定的漢族地區佛教全國重點寺院之一。
Très beau monastère bouddhiste. L'endroit parfait pour découvrir la culture et profiter d'un petit thé
希望すれば精進料理も頂けます。国慶節でもあり狭い境内に人が多すぎました。 時期も考えないと大変です。ここの場所は文殊院駅から近く歩いて５分程度、静かなお寺です。
Très beau temple bouddhiste constitué d'un ensemble de bâtiments et jardin au coeur de Chengdu. Beaucoup de locaux y viennent pour prier, c'est très facile d'accès, et l'architecture vaut le détour!

reviews.text: เป็นอีก แห่ง Monastery ที่อยู่ใจกลางเมือง มีรูปเคารพ ในความรู้สึก วัดนี้ ผ่านช่วงความวุ่นวาย อยู่หลายครั้ง และได้บูรณะซ่อมแซมเป็นระยะๆ

到此無二心只知念佛 個中證三昧全在當人 文殊院位於四川成都市區中心地帶，是集禪林聖跡、園林名勝、朝拜修學於一體的佛教寺院。是中國長江上下游四大禪林之首，設有戒壇，為周邊四川僧俗受戒之道場。1980年7月7日公佈為四川省文物保護單位。 它的前身是唐代的妙圓塔院，宋時改稱“信相寺”。後毀於兵災。傳說清代有人夜見紅光出現，官府派人探視，見紅光中有文殊菩薩像，便於康熙三十六年（1697年）集資重建廟宇，稱文殊院。康熙帝御筆“空林”二字，欽賜“敕賜空林”禦印一方。康熙帝墨蹟至今仍存院內。
ภายในวัด สงบเงียบ เรียบร้อย ดูศักดิ์สิทธิ์ วัดเก่าแก่เป็นพันปีค่ะ ที่สำคัญเข้าชมฟรีค่ะ
Ciekawa architektura, miejscw godne uwagi. W poblizu sklepy z pamiatkami, stragany. Warto sie wybrac.

文殊院是成都當地知名佛教聖地，它位於文殊坊景區內，成都地鐵1號線，就有文殊院站，看著站內的指示，很容易找到文殊院，但一定要留意開放參觀時間，網上可查到。我們是在平日到達文殊院，在到達文殊院前的道路，就可以感受到濃濃的文青味，與古樸典雅的氣息。道路兩旁有很多店家，但有別於一般的商店街，這裏的店家外觀也是走古樸風，讓人忍不住會多拍幾張照片，留下到此一遊的身影。走一小段路，就可到達文殊院。進到文殊院，整個人馬上沉浸在佛教寺院的祥和氛圍，這裏不像是一般的景區。來到此處的遊客，都懷著一顆虔誠的心，祈求寺內聖者的庇祐與開示。看見每一位遊客虔誠的膜拜寺內諸神，感受到佛渡眾生的慈悲心。這樣的心靈療癒能量，遠超任何一種心靈洗滌的方法。雖是平日，但到此的遊客很多，寺內的建築、擺設、園內植栽，莊嚴肅穆，很能平靜遊客的心。來到成都，一定記得到文殊院，感受一下佛教聖地的聖潔氛圍。

Estabamos ya cansados de tanto temllo parecido, pero disfrutamos de esta visita y nos aprecio diferente a otros vistos. PROS: - Entrada gratuita - No es muy grande y evita las salas repetitivas que tienen la mayoria de templos. - Las esculturas son relativamente modernas, bien conservadas y bonitas. - Hay mucha gente rezando y trabajando. Se nota que hay movimiento y esta activo. - La calle de delante tiene unos edificios bonitos y un paseo agradable
